_comment: Flavour text for plain interactable signs. Keyed by scene name, then by the CollisionShape2D node name under that scene's 'Interactables' node. Special shapes ('Bed', 'TV') are handled in code and need no entry here.

Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Shop: Celeste Harbour Card Mart — packs, singles and supplies.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Beach_Left_Big: Beach access. Mind the tide times!
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Beach_Right_Small: Please keep the beach clean. Bins provided.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Left_Dock_Left: West Dock — fishing boats only beyond this point.

Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Right_Dock_Right: Cargo loading area — authorised personnel only.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Shop_Holo: Holo Mart — rare holographic cards bought and sold.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Shop_Coin: Coin Mart — collectible coins for every trainer.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Shop_Right: Celeste Harbour General Store — everyday essentials.
Celeste_Harbour.Sign_Shop_Lighthouse: Celeste Lighthouse — guiding ships safely home.
